title: maint.event.v1{kind=dlq_drop_request}
description: Phase 8 §8.15.9 — operator command sent by the ops console to explicitly drop a specific DLQ entry without replaying it. The DLQ supervisor (maint.dlq.v1) acks and emits kind=dlq_dropped{reason=operator_drop} with forensic fields for the audit channel.

target.description: The DLQ topic the entry lives in (e.g. predict.vote.dlq).

request_id.description: Operator-supplied idempotency key. Returned verbatim in the maint.ack.v1 so the ops console can correlate.

dlq_entry_id.description: Stable identifier of the specific DLQ entry to drop.

original_request_id.description: The request_id of the original failed envelope (informational — used in the dlq_dropped forensic audit payload).

original_envelope_summary.description: §8.15.5-capped summary of the original failed envelope. Forwarded verbatim into dlq_dropped for the audit channel.

drop_reason.description: Operator-supplied free-text reason for the explicit drop.

dropped_by.description: Operator key fingerprint / identity initiating the drop. Forwarded to dlq_dropped for the audit trail.

op_signed_at.description: §8.14.4 ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the opsctl signature was created.
